al_3.atHtml: no Temple neededBali's most photographed temple gate with Mt. Agung framed perfectly between split gates. Entry ~IDR 100k. The "floating" reflection is done with a mirror/water held under the gate by attendants.📸 #1 Most iconic Bali photo

Tirta Gangga Water PalaceFormer royal water palace with elegant stepped pools, giant koi fish, stone stepping paths, and lush gardens against a highland backdrop. Entry IDR 90k. You can swim in the bathing pools.📸 Stepping stones, lotus pools, Agung backdrop

al_0.atHtml: Sanur Beachfront Boardwalk5 km paved path lined with colourful jukung boats — Bali's most photogenic fishing boats. Walk north toward Sunrise Beach area.📸 Photo: boats against Agung volcano backdrop
Pura Blanjong TempleOldest dated inscription in Bali (914 AD). Small, serene, very local — just 10 min walk inland from beach.
Sindhu Beach MarketA small afternoon market near Jl. Danau Tamblingan selling local snacks, fresh coconut, batik wraps. Great intro to local life.📸 Photo: colourful offerings & daily life
Sanur Sunrise Beach ViewpointDespite the name, beautiful at any time. Clear views of Nusa Penida and Mt. Agung. Perfect golden hour shot.📸 Photo: golden hour Agung reflection

al_6.atHtml:
Puri Saren Agung – Ubud Palace
🗺️ Maps: Add Map Link
Still-occupied royal palace at the heart of Ubud. Free entry. Beautiful split gates (candi bentar), carved thrones, frangipani-filled courtyards. Evening Kecak dance shows here.📸 Golden gates, courtyard carvings

Ubud Art Market (Pasar Seni)
🗺️ Maps: Add Map Link
Right opposite the palace. Two floors of batik, carved wooden masks, rattan bags, silver jewellery, paintings. Bargain hard — start at 30–40% of asking price.

Jalan Bisma Walk
🗺️ Maps: Add Map Link
Your hotel's street is one of Ubud's most beautiful — a quiet road with rice terrace views and excellent boutique restaurants. Great evening stroll.📸 Gorge views along Bisma ridge

al_5.atHtml:
Celuk – Silver & Gold Village
🗺️ Maps: Add Map Link
Bali's jewellery heartland. Watch master silversmiths work by hand. Excellent place to buy authentic Balinese silver jewellery. Start at smaller workshops on side streets for better prices.

Mas – Wood Carving Village
🗺️ Maps: Add Map Link
Roadside galleries of intricate handmade Garuda statues, masks, panels. Great for quality gifts and art.

Tegalalang Rice Terraces
🗺️ Maps: Add Map Link
UNESCO-listed emerald terraced paddies plunging into a gorge. Swing & zip-line activities available. Arrive 9 AM for best light and fewer people.📸 Iconic Bali rice terrace, gorge shots

transport.t_4: Walking Day + 1 Hired Car for Afternoon Morning is all walkable from your Bisma villa. Campuhan Ridge Walk starts 10 min walk from the villa. Afternoon: hire a driver (IDR 200–300k half day) for Tanah Lot sunset. Or take Grab to specific spots.
transport.t_0: Transport Airport → Sanur: Pre-book a private cab or use Bluebird taxi (metered, most reliable). ~30–40 min, ~IDR 150–200k. Avoid touts inside arrivals. All Sanur activities are walkable along the 5 km beach boardwalk. Rent bicycles (IDR 50k/day) from your hotel for easy exploration.
